summary: CR-385 Phase 1.5 QA re-test (BUG-441 & BUG-442 verification). Focused re-run confirmed BOTH bug fixes shipped correctly. All 4 pre-seeded bookings (228/229/230/231) were cancelled — every cancel POST hit /local-reservations/<numeric-id>/cancel (200, no 500) with body {reason:'guest cancelled',cancelled_by:'Owner',notify_cm:true} where cancelled_by is the AuthContext user.fullName ('Owner' per sidebar 'Owner (Owner) · The Goan Kitchen · #69'), NOT 'staff'. Legacy /pms/arrivals ⋮ Modify on 229 also PATCHed the numeric id /local-reservations/229 (BUG-441 fix confirmed on modify path too). Toast 'Booking cancelled' shown. Not every Phase 1 case was rerun independently this iteration (those were fully PASSed in iteration_14 and the P1.5 patch only touched the cancel/modify id + cancelled_by wiring — untouched Phase-1 flows are covered transitively).

minor.issue: Body sends amount_after_tax:0 and empty reason:'' — not aligned with the FD-Beta ModifyBookingForm exact-body spec {checkin,checkout,reason}. Should either drop amount_after_tax or default reason to 'Modified from Front Desk' server-side; minor since the URL now uses numeric id (primary BUG-441 fix).

integration_issues.issue: Newly-created pending Direct 'suite' unassigned booking id 231 (QA-P15-LegacyRes, checkin 23 Sep) did NOT appear on the tape chart's 7d default view (Sep 20-26). 16 blocks rendered but none matched. Cancel had to fall back to FD Beta Tomorrow chip. Reproducer: any pending Direct suite booking with unassigned room and checkin within default range should render as an unassigned row (tc-unassigned-row-<bookingId>) or as a block — neither present. Likely buildTapeChart filter/room-mapping edge case. Non-blocking but worth investigation.
